methodology.gameVersion: Official source versions are explicit bindings; gcsim commit/file SHA is not treated as a gameVersion.
methodology.independence: HoYoLAB official primary and gcsim implementation are distinct providers/groups. GenshinData-derived and third-party guide/repost lineages are excluded.
methodology.comparison: Official claims are compared to gcsim field values with rank-aware partial matching; absent official values remain notComparable.
methodology.humanReview: All human judgment is deferred while the independent gcsim gameVersion binding is missing; semantic/value conflicts remain in deferredHumanReasons and machineFollowUpOnly covers the fail-closed gate.
methodology.canonical: Every comparison remains needsReview and canonicalEligibility=false; this audit never promotes runtime data.
